patch_description: Combines the parameter economy of the current one-angle block with the better-performing gate ordering of the two-angle inspiration. Each repetition uses one shared parameter across collective RY and RZ layers, preserving only 8 total trainable parameters, while placing the CZ chain between the layers to create a more expressive rotation–entanglement–rotation sandwich. This retains the current parameter efficiency and convergence advantage while targeting the lower validation and test losses of the inspiration.
